title: Who would you like to chat with?
intro: No lessons here. Find someone you click with and talk about life, travel, or anything unexpected.
clearRecentConfirm: Clear recent chat dates? Your saved shared topics will remain.
recentEmpty: People you've spoken with will appear here for easy follow-up.
noMatches: No matching friends. Try a different name or interest.
privacy: Only actual chat dates are recorded. Topic memory is on by default and can be disabled or cleared in Settings. Friends are fictional AI characters, not real users who are online.
disabled: Conversation memory is off. Turn it on in Settings → Memory.
disabledHint: Conversation memory is off. Enable it in Settings → Memory.
noTopics: No shared topics yet. A single meaningful conversation can create memories; you can also add one manually.
clearTopicsConfirm: Delete all shared topics with this friend?

capture.empty: No lasting topic was found in the latest conversation.
capture.error: This memory capture failed. Previously saved memories are safe.
capture.error-key: The Gemini Key cannot access memory extraction. Check text-model permissions in Settings (separate from live voice).
capture.error-quota: The Gemini text-model rate or usage limit was reached. Try later or review quota in AI Studio.
capture.error-network: The memory request could not connect. Previously saved memories are safe.
capture.error-service: Gemini memory extraction is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
capture.error-response: Gemini returned an unreadable memory response. No new memory was added this time.

chatModes.natural: Natural chat · target language + native help
